title: tectaria tricuspis
intro: Tectaria tricuspis, commonly known as the three-toothed tectaria fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria tricuspis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
